effectSize: Small additional FFM/strength gains vs training alone; plateau ~1.6 g/kg/day
limitations: Supplement vs food protein poorly distinguished
title: A systematic review, meta-analysis and meta-regression of the effect of protein supplementation on resistance training-induced gains in muscle mass and strength in healthy adults

keyFinding.enGB: Protein supplementation modestly augments resistance-training gains in muscle mass and strength in healthy adults, with diminishing returns beyond roughly 1.6 g·kg⁻¹·day⁻¹ total protein.
keyFinding.uk: Добавки білка помірно підсилюють прирости м’язової маси та сили від силових тренувань у здорових дорослих, зі зменшенням віддачі понад приблизно 1,6 г·кг⁻¹·день⁻¹ загального білка.

evidenceGrade.rationale: Large SR/MA/meta-regression of RCTs in healthy adults.
